caption:
Sure your quiet, ordinary work isn't enough? That's what builds it. (1 Timothy 4:13–14 devotional)

We chase the spectacular and overlook the ordinary. Paul points Timothy to reading, teaching, exhortation — the quiet, repeated word. The church isn't built by fireworks in the sky, but the hearth fire that warms the room.

📌 Save this for your quiet time this week
